thread:
mike.finance: Heads up — CloudRack sent a refund reversal for invoice CR-2024-998, amount $18,450. It had been processed as a vendor credit last month; reversal hit this period. Need rev-rec guidance for month close.

jordan.accounting: Can you paste the original journal and the reversal entry? Also whether the original was applied against deferred revenue or recognized as revenue.

mike.finance: Original credit memo applied to prepaid commit (deferred revenue). The reversal came through as a contra-credit to accounts payable. Quick copy of entries from ERP:```
2025-02-12  GL: 2100 Deferred Revenue     CR   18,450
            GL: 2000 Cash/Bank           DR   18,450  (original vendor credit applied)
2025-03-15  GL: 2000 Cash/Bank           CR   18,450
            GL: 2010 AP - CloudRack      DR   18,450  (refund reversal)```

olivia.revrec: If the original was a reduction of deferred revenue, the reversal should increase deferred revenue (i.e., restore the liability) unless we had already recognized that portion as revenue in prior periods. Do we have any of that $18.45k recognized to revenue because of consumption?

sara.billing: The credit was posted against a customer committed contract (prepay) and reduced our deferred balance. No downstream recognition tied to that specific credit — it lowered the liability only.

jordan.accounting: Given that, revrec treatment is to reinstate deferred revenue (DR: Cash/Bank CR? wait) — we should book a reversing entry to increase deferred revenue and offset AP/Cash. Proposed month-end journal:```
2025-03-31  GL: 2100 Deferred Revenue     CR   18,450
            GL: 2010 AP - CloudRack      DR   18,450```

mike.finance: That matches my thinking. But because reversal posted to Cash/AP already, we need a clean correcting adjustment so P&L isn't impacted.

olivia.revrec: Agreed. Please document the rationale: vendor credit reversal restores prior liability reduction. No revenue impact if original change only touched deferrals. We'll note as "correction of prior-period liability" in the close memo.

anna.cfo: @mike.finance @jordan.accounting I need the memo + GL support in the close bucket within the hour for consolidation. If there's any risk this touches revenue recognition policies, flag it now.

mike.finance: On it — drafting memo and attaching screenshots. One quick question: do we want to create an accrual instead and net it against a monthly clearing account until the vendor confirms final status? That would avoid jumping balances in consolidated close right now.

jordan.accounting: That would complicate the audit trail. Unless CloudRack confirms formal reversal is tentative, we should do the direct reinstatement. Any contingency should be disclosed, not accrued.

close-bot: Reminder — month-end lock in 2 hours. Please post all adjustments with supporting docs to #finance-monthclose.

sara.billing: I'll ping CloudRack AM to confirm whether this reversal is final or a system error. ETA ~30m.

mike.finance: Thanks. I'll hold the journal until we get their confirmation, but I'm preparing the memo to submit if they confirm. Will update thread when reply from vendor arrives. :thumbsup:
